pro_course_detail.title: 📚 Reading Skills: Bite-Sized Books for Kids! 📚
pro_course_detail.description:
🌟 I’m excited to introduce a reading course that’s anything but ordinary. This isn’t just about learning to read—it’s about falling in love with reading! Using my original Kiddoland curriculum, we’ll focus exclusively on the reading component to supercharge your child’s literacy skills in a way that’s fun, engaging, and incredibly effective.  

Here’s what makes this course special:  
✨ Bite-Sized Books, Big Results: Each session, we’ll dive into a brand-new “Bite-Sized Book” with its own unique theme, vocabulary, and skill set to practice. These manageable, exciting books are designed to keep kids motivated and eager to read more.  

🚀 Reading Made Fun: Who says reading has to be a chore? With a game-like approach, we’ll turn every session into an exciting event! Through high-energy, gamified strategies and immersive language activities, we’ll bring stories to life, making reading as addictive as their favorite video games.  

📚 Diverse & Engaging Content: From fiction and fairy tales to non-fiction, we’ll explore a variety of genres, helping your child understand what makes each one unique. This diversity keeps lessons fresh and exciting, while building their confidence and fluency across different types of texts.  

🎯 Positive Reading Experiences: By creating a joyful and supportive environment, we’ll help your child develop a positive association with reading. This not only improves their speed and comprehension but also fosters a lifelong love of books.  

Ready to turn reading into an adventure? Let’s go! 🚀

pro_course_detail.title: ✨Exam Prep: KET, PET, FCE and more for Kids!✨
pro_course_detail.description:
🌟 I am a certified Cambridge Examiner and have taught and tested PET, KET, FCE, CAE, CPE and IELTS. I’m thrilled to offer a unique and effective approach to Cambridge exam preparation that combines fast fluency building with targeted exam practice. Whether your child is aiming for KET, PET, or even higher-level exams like FCE or CAE, this course is designed to help them succeed with confidence and ease!  

✨ Fluency Meets Exam Success: I leverage my proven fluency course, Kiddoland, to build a strong foundation in English quickly. But here’s the twist—we integrate exam practice into every skill from the very beginning. This means your child not only becomes fluent but also masters the techniques needed to ace their exam.  

🚀 Skill-by-Skill Mastery: We’ll tackle each exam skill—reading, writing, listening, and speaking—one at a time. Starting with the basics, we’ll practice, refine, and gradually add complexity until your child is fully prepared for the challenges of their exam. This step-by-step approach ensures no skill is left behind!  

📚 Personalized & Engaging: Every lesson is tailored to your child’s interests, ability level, and exam goals. By focusing on topics they love, we create a fun and immersive learning environment that keeps them motivated and excited to learn.  

🎯 Full Immersion with Expert Guidance: In 1:1 sessions, your child gets undivided attention and constant feedback from me, a certified Cambridge Examiner. We’ll create a full-immersion experience where they communicate with a native speaker, refine their pronunciation, and build confidence in all areas of English.  

Yes, this course is an investment—but what you get is a one-of-a-kind learning journey that’s engaging, effective, and entirely tailored to your child’s needs. Together, we’ll set clear goals, track progress, and celebrate every milestone along the way.  

Ready to help your child achieve fluency and exam success? Let’s make it happen! 🚀

pro_course_detail.title: 🗣 Speaking Skills: Advanced speaking for Kids & Teens 🗣
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to my "Freestyle" Conversation Class! 🎉 This class is perfect for teens and advanced kids who are at an intermediate level (CEFR-B1) or higher. We’ll use a fun and proven methodology to guarantee your learning success!

teacher_info.intro: I love figuring out different ways to help improve English learners who are stuck in their English progress. My favorite areas of English is exam prep (TOEFL, IELTS, etc.)
teacher_info.introduction: Welcome dear friends. My name is Ben. I have a BA degree in psychology and social behavior, MA in English Language Teaching, and a TEFL teaching certificate. I am a professional English teacher originally from Southern California and am currently residing in Northern California for the moment being. I'm eager to work with students of all levels (beginner, elementary, intermediate, upper-intermediate, advanced). I'm very patient, friendly (I like meeting new people), and eager to cooperate and teach students in a manner that is stress-free and encourages their language learning development. After having traveled abroad and living in a different country for 4 years I've came to realize that many people move to a new country completely unprepared and feel lost and worried. They do not have the survival English to find a job, call for an emergency, fill out a form, order food, find a special store, use a taxi, get directions or communicate efficiently at all . As a result, my lessons are heavily tailored to developing strong conversation or speaking skills (which develop all four skills speaking, listening, reading, writing) and also learning about the culture, thinking, and behavior of English speakers, and finally developing different lessons and materials based on whatever you need English for and in a manner where you will learn to become an independent English learner so you can feel as comfortable as a native English speaker without ever feeling like you're lost. Be patient and work hard with me and you'll learn how to survive and work with the English language, make good friends, enjoy the language and even use it to travel the world.
teacher_info.about_me: I love figuring out different ways to help improve English learners who are stuck in their English progress. Not only do I use the knowledge I've gained from not just college and university, but also my own personal insight and experiences to give them insight, methods and strategies to work on their shortcomings and experience progress. My favorite areas of English is exam prep (TOEFL, IELTS, etc.)
teacher_info.about_teacher: I have university degrees in English language teaching and psychology. I've worked in schools, institutes, universities. I've taught English learners who were doctors, pharmacists, lawyers, computer programmers, engineers, scientists, inventors, entrepreneurs and even social media influencers (YouTubers and TikTokers). pro_course_detail.title: General German for Beginners to Elementary (A1-A2)

Would you like to build up a strong foundation in German? Do you already know some basic expressions or are you starting to learn the language from scratch? Then this course is for you!

We will use an A1 or A2 level book series to learn vocabulary, practise speaking on a variety of everyday topics, and ease into grammar. Whether you aim to spend some time in a German-speaking country, learn something new, or one day speak German to family, friends, and loved ones, we will work to develop your ability to express yourself and understand spoken and written German for use in everyday life. 

Students will be assigned light homework exercises to review vocabulary and structures covered in class before the next lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Lesestunde: German Reading and Writing (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
In order to improve your reading and writing skills we will practise different reading techniques and strategies and look at writing as a process. During our German lessons we will read an interesting text - at times aloud, at times individually - before completing exercises that will help to strengthen your understanding of the text and expand your vocabulary. You will learn how to avoid writing mistakes and how to successfully structure and edit your own writing so that is easily readable. 
 
Our aim in this course is not to seek perfection or mistake-free German, but rather to strive towards an understandable use of the language in speech and writing and deepen your joy of reading.
 
Um Ihre Lese- und Schreibfertigkeiten zu verbessern werden wir zusammen unterschiedliche Lesetechniken und -strategien üben und das Schreiben als Prozess betrachten. Während der Deutschstunde lesen wir mal vor, mal als Einzelarbeit, und erledigen Aufgaben, die Ihr Verständnis des Textes verfestigen und ihren Wortschatz erweitern sollen. Sie werden lernen wie man Schreibfehler vermeiden kann und einen gut lesbaren Text erfolgreich aufbaut und bearbeitet. 
 
Wir streben nicht nach Perfektion oder fehlerfreiem Deutsch, sondern nach einer verständlichen Sprache in Wort und Schrift und mehr Freude am Lesen.

pro_course_detail.title: Book Club: Reading and Writing in English (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course you will improve your use of English by reading, discussing, and writing about thought-provoking essays, interviews, articles, and stories of various lengths and types. We will practise reading aloud and individually during our English lessons, although at times you may be asked to read a chapter or medium-length short story at home to prepare for our discussion in the next lesson. We will look at different strategies for using a text to learn new vocabulary, complete comprehension exercises in order to strengthen your understanding of key ideas in the text, and learn to structure and edit your own stories, essays and written responses.
 
Our aim in this course is not to seek perfection or mistake-free English, but rather to strive towards an effective use of the language in speech and writing and deepen your joy of reading.

pro_course_detail.title: Exploring the Canon: A Light Reading of English Classics (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
If you’ve ever wanted to tackle Beowulf or a Shakespearean play in a stress-free, non-academic setting, this course is for you!

In this course we will read and discuss a handful of English-language texts that have served as the inspiration for art, poetry, drama, and film from their conception to the modern day. We will take a look at both historical and modern works, including plays, short stories, essays and longer works, some of which may be adapted for the modern reader. Although our discussions and activities will be loosely structured on key themes and elements of style in the texts, students are encouraged to bring their own discussion questions and ideas to class.

A modest, manageable amount of at-home reading may be assigned depending on the work we are covering. Students are advised to take their time with the material and wait to book the next lesson until they have completed the reading.

pro_course_detail.title: Learn more about yourself while mastering English
pro_course_detail.description: In this 8-series offer, we use the Clifton Strengths assessment to understand more deeply who you are what how you naturally function in the world.  During the first lesson, you will take the assessment and then we will start going over the results and talk about some of the basics.  From there, in each lesson we will do a deep dive into your top 10 results (the things that make you, uniquely you) as well as your bottom 5 (as you want to make sure you're not spending time there).  From this exploration, most students find they have a deeper understanding of who they are and why they do things the way they do as well as having the vocabulary to express that.
